what_works: High contrast dark primary text on a light background ensures excellent readability.
Generous use of white space with consistent 4‑12 px spacing creates an airy, organized layout.
Large rounded corners give a contemporary, soft aesthetic while maintaining structural clarity.
Clear visual hierarchy with bold headline, sub‑headline, and prominent call‑to‑action button.
Strategic color accent (yellow sign‑up button) draws attention without disrupting the overall minimal palette.
